summary: The official City of Oshawa public ArcGIS parcel service was reachable anonymously and returned three bounded parcel polygons with stable PARCELID identities. The exact WUP point returned zero features, which is only a point-query outcome and not evidence of citywide absence. Runtime admission remains held pending independent serial review.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French-Canada discovery queries are recorded in city-3218-oshawa.json. English discovery found the official City of Oshawa parcel service and metadata; French discovery found no separate local-language endpoint, with the English official service serving as the applicable local source.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official City of Oshawa map host reachable; no login, CAPTCHA or challenge encountered.
Current layer metadata retrieved: polygon layer, EPSG:26917, safe PARCELID field, GeoJSON query support.
Official OpenData parcel layer metadata independently confirmed the same polygon parcel theme and PARCELID field.
Exact WUP point queried with inSR=4326, outSR=4326, returnGeometry=true and outFields=PARCELID; zero features returned. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

Bounded envelope around Oshawa queried anonymously with returnGeometry=true, outFields=PARCELID, resultRecordCount=3 and outSR=4326; three full polygons returned, with exceededTransferLimit=true indicating more features exist in the envelope.
Official parcel metadata documents property-boundary purpose, daily maintenance/weekly refresh claims, NAD83 UTM Zone 17N, and reference-only legal disclaimer.

Durham regional viewer configuration identified a separate Assessment Parcels map service; not queried for geometry because the City of Oshawa service already provided confirmed local parcel evidence.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved latitude/longitude; ArcGIS geometry parameter supplied longitude/latitude. No coordinate shift applied.

nativeFieldMapping.PARCELID: stable native parcel identity returned by the City of Oshawa layer
nativeFieldMapping.geometry: native polygon geometry returned as GeoJSON in EPSG:4326

crs.retainedSample: EPSG:4326 GeoJSON output; source geometry is transformed by the official ArcGIS query

geometryQuality: Three unchanged polygon geometries retained from the official service, limited to three features and reduced properties to canonical id only.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Zero exact-point features; bounded nearby extent produced three parcel features.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous metadata and bounded ID-plus-geometry access; no independent citywide completeness audit performed.

scopeLimits: The official metadata says the data is reference-only and not a substitute for legal, real-estate, survey or City staff advice.
Exact WUP point miss is not evidence of parcel absence or citywide source absence.
Bounded sample proves service response and parcel-like geometry, not completeness, legal title, or universal identity stability.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: Parcel completeness, legal status, authoritative cadastral standing, update currency beyond published metadata, and adapter suitability require independent serial review.
